description: Config message parser in src/ using a base64 decoder and byte helpers in compat/

bugs.trigger: msg_parse or msg_peer_ip: field ip= followed by 8 or more base64 characters; b64_decode checks o >= cap before writing a 3-byte group, so the second group overflows uint8_t ip[4] (stack). Also msg_b64 with 22 or more groups into cap 64 (heap)

decoys.why: internal helper (declared in compat/compat.h, not include/), only called on a 4-byte buffer after a successful 4-byte decode; called directly on a short buffer it reads out of bounds

lexer_expected: Control case. The lexer resolves the direct call parse_ip -> b64_decode, so module 'msg' has required_sources [compat/b64.c, src/msg.c] and S06-1 is reachable from msg_parse; module 'compat' also exposes b64_decode directly. It offers load_be32 as a 'compat' entry point, whose harness crashes at compat/b64.c:53 (false positive, verified).
